To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) AI and ML methods are of high importance for molecular medicine and (2) that the application of AI and ML methods in molecular medicine will be further enhanced by novel developments and applications of AI and ML itself.

(1) AI and ML methods are increasingly important for molecular medicine, (2) the application of AI and ML methods in molecular medicine is not yet fully developed, (3) the development of novel methods is needed for further progress in the field, (4) there is a need to establish a community that is dedicated to the development of AI, ML, and DS in molecular medicine and (5) the Bioinformatics andAI section is a good place to publish such research.

(1) AI and ML can be used for the analysis of all molecular data, (2) the analysis of such data is crucial to understand molecular mechanisms of health and disease, and (3) AI and ML are essential for the development of precision medicine.

the following topics.
the development of novel AI and ML approaches to address the following grand challenges in molecular medicine: 1.
the analysis of high dimensional data, such as gene expression data or other molecular measurements.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are still at an early stage of the development of AI for molecular medicine, but we are confident that this will change in the near future.
AI, ML and DS are of great importance for molecular medicine.
the future of molecular medicine will depend to a large extent on the further development of data science methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AI and ML are essential for the development of molecular medicine and vice versa.
the application of AI and ML methods to the analysis of Omics data is a powerful tool for the discovery of novel insights into the molecular mechanisms of health and disease.

we are interested in the development of methods for the analysis of high dimensional and heterogeneous data for the understanding of the molecular mechanisms of disease, for the prediction of disease states and for the discovery of novel therapeutic approaches (Figure 1).
The main takeaway from our work is that
the field of molecular medicine is in need for an integrative approach of AI and ML to advance our understanding of the molecular processes underlying disease and health.
the application of AI and ML to molecular medicine requires a multidisciplinary approach involving biologists, clinicians, computer scientists, mathematicians, physicists and statisticians.
AI and ML are already a major part of molecular medicine and will continue to grow in importance.
